text:
nate: heads-up: nightly CI hit a flake in runtime unit tests — `kv_cache_stale_read_test` failing on macos-arm runner. Happens ~1/50 runs, stack looks like a timing-dependent cache invalidation. Log excerpt below.

sam: oof. can you paste the failing log + job link? did it fail on mac only? :eyes:

nate: job: https://ci.internal/redwood/job/7421
log snippet: `AssertionError: expected value X but got stale Y at kv_cache.cc:214`
observed on macos-arm-1 and macos-arm-3, linux runners clean so far.

ci-bot: Rerun requested by @sam — https://ci.internal/redwood/job/7421/rerun/1 (queued)

maya: could be nondet eviction order when two timers fire close together. any seed/trace info?

nate: test prints RNG seed on failure: seed=8453271. Also added small repro harness command: 
```
RUNTIME_TEST_SEED=8453271 RUST_BACKTRACE=1 cargo test kv_cache_stale_read_test -- --nocapture
```

kevin: quick idea: add deterministic clock injection or bump the retry backoff in test to rule out races. if reproducer is cheap, run bisect to find commit that introduced nondet.

sam: re-run returned (CI): rerun 1 -> same failure on macos-arm-3. ci-bot: https://ci.internal/redwood/job/7421/rerun/1/result

maya: can you try local loop 100x with that seed and run on mac VM? might need to reproduce on linux under qemu but start with macos runner.

nate: starting local loop on mac VM now. command: 
```
for i in {1..100}; do RUNTIME_TEST_SEED=8453271 cargo test kv_cache_stale_read_test -- --nocapture || break; done
```

sam: tagging @kevin in case you want to bisect. if failing is rare, we can use `git bisect run` with the repro script.

kevin: I can start a bisect tomorrow morning. before that, quick check: are there recent patches to KV prefetch/timers? I recall 3 PRs last week touching expiry. PRs: #1823, #1827, #1830.

nate: yes, #1830 changed eviction to prefer LRU+timer coalescing. I suspect ordering change.

maya: pragmatic short-term fix: add a guard in the test to wait-for-stable-state (poll kv->drain() or sleep 20ms) to reduce flakiness while we bisect. then we can revert.

sam: agree, but prefer minimal change to test so it doesn't mask real bug. maybe assert with a retry loop for small window instead of blind sleep.

nate: will open quick PR with retry-based assertion + repro script in test/ci-repro.sh and mention bisect plan. linking here when posted.

ci-bot: Rerun queued by @nate for additional traces: https://ci.internal/redwood/job/7421/rerun/2

kevin: thanks — I'll kick off `git bisect` against master once PR is in so we have a baseline. if bisect points to #1830 I'll prepare a targeted fix for coalescing logic.

nate: PR created: https://git.internal/redwood/pulls/1845 — adds small retry loop and repro script. PTAL.

sam: LGTM for test-only change, merge when green. kevin, keep us posted on bisect outcome.

maya: also adding a short debug flag to enable extra eviction logging in runtime to help trace order if bisect is noisy. can toggle via `RUNTIME_DEBUG_EVICT=1` in CI.

kevin: noted. starting bisect tomorrow. thanks all. :rocket:
